purpose: Owner-controlled eSIM Access catalog, balance, API purchase, inventory, and explicit booking assignment inside iumrah Business.
notes: eSIM purchases spend the eSIM Access merchant balance; card data is not stored in iumrah Business.
Client app changes are intentionally out of scope for this update.
Fixed-data plans only in this first purchasing UI; Day Pass plans require periodNum and are excluded to prevent incorrect billing.
Purchase confirmation is price-locked against the latest provider tariff to prevent unexpected charges.
Provider auth supports RT-AccessCode-only mode and HMAC signing when ESIM_ACCESS_SECRET is configured.
